title: Focus Now
behavior.fullscreen.hint: Focused windows cover the screen until you hover elsewhere. Fullscreen you set yourself is never touched.
behavior.sticky.hint: Windows stay fullscreen after losing focus instead of restoring.
behavior.near.hint: Focused windows grow to the share set below; neighbors compress into the rest.
row.hoverDelay.hint: Pointer rest time before a window expands. 0 is instant.
row.fullscreenDelay.hint: Pause after a managed window unfullscreens before hover expansion resumes.
row.width.hint: Focused window's share of the work-area width.
row.height.hint: Focused window's share of the work-area height.
hint.multipliers: Steps snap to presets from 25% to 95%. Neighbors keep a small sliver on each axis — use Fullscreen for edge-to-edge. With no neighbor on an axis, the window claims the full width or height.
hint.expansionOff: Expansion is off — hover focus and scrolling-column centering still work, and any Focus Now-managed fullscreen is restored. Windows keep their normal tiled size.
behavior.refocus.hint: Move the pointer to the center of a window focused without mouse input (keybinds, menus). Off prevents cursor jumps inside apps.
